verdict.rationale: Forter is a fraud-decisioning platform, so team review workflows are a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence pack documents no manual review queue with assignment, escalation, SLAs, or a decision audit trail showing who approved what and why. The only nearby mention is that the MCP server lets an AI system perform actions 'such as reviewing decisions'. That is an adjacent AI-agent feature, not a team review workflow.

support.subject: As an ops user, review work is a team workflow — assignment, escalation, SLAs, and a decision audit trail that shows who approved what and why
